title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

reports.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

summary:
U.S. intelligence officials say Russia has authorized covert online disinformation operations aimed at undermining public confidence in November’s midterm elections. The classified assessments found the Kremlin is using social media to amplify domestic divisions, but there is no evidence it is targeting voting machines or the actual voting process. Experts have recently spotted AI-generated fake videos of Hollywood celebrities discussing key Senate races. Officials say this campaign appears less extensive or coordinated than some past Russian efforts.

Russia has run influence operations in every American federal election cycle since 2016, according to declassified assessments. U.S. spy agencies believe Moscow is less focused on midterm races than presidential contests and is distracted by the war in Ukraine. The article does not specify what actions the U.S. government will take next.
